Tool: recognize_support_spend_78bce399
Description: Record an agent's measured eligible-spending contribution for a support invoice source. The contract gains a posted primary consumption entry; success supplies its reference and recorded quantity, which are immediately visible in consumption history. A success string containing the created consumption reference as a string and the recorded supported_usd quantity as a six-place decimal; 'Spending recorded' confirms that the contribution is posted.
Parameters:
  - customer_id: string (required) - Id class — enterprise customer reference number copied from the located customer profile.
  - support_holding_id: string (required) - Id class — support contract reference number copied from the contract lookup.
  - support_event_id: string (required) - Id class — review-designated official spending export reference number copied exactly from the selected latest billing review's related_event_id returned by support event lookup; this identifies the aggregate's evidence locator, and another export fragment's identifier is not a substitute.
  - source_event_id: string (required) - Id class — original support invoice-line reference number copied from the retrieved export.
  - quantity: number (required) - Fixed-format class — eligible spending in supported_usd, format Decimal quantity to six decimal places; unit as specified, rounded half up before submission; the submitted value is stored at six-place precision.
  - period: string (required) - Fixed-format class — service billing month in YYYY-MM format, UTC calendar month; an empty value is not allowed.
  - interval_start: string (required) - Fixed-format class — inclusive service start as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.
  - interval_end: string (required) - Fixed-format class — exclusive service end as format ISO timestamp or empty string in UTC, with second precision; an empty value is not allowed.

You can now use this tool by calling `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with tool_name='recognize_support_spend_78bce399' and the required arguments.

Tool: review_support_invoice_795b85b5
Description: Complete the agent accountant's support invoice review. The selected review becomes approved with an incorrect-billing decision, a corrected net fee, zero tax and reconciled physical quantity. The resulting review and its corrected fee become visible immediately; success confirms the saved review reference. A success string with the reviewed reference as a string and corrected USD net fee as a two-place decimal; 'Review completed' confirms the approved incorrect-billing review is saved.
Parameters:
  - support_event_id: string (required) - Id class — pending billing review reference number copied from support event lookup.
  - support_holding_id: string (required) - Id class — reviewed support contract reference number copied from that review.
  - source_event_id: string (required) - Id class — original invoice-line reference number copied from that review.
  - related_event_id: string (required) - Id class — supporting official export reference number copied from that review.
  - net_amount: number (required) - Fixed-format class — corrected pretax support fee in USD, format USD to two decimals; unit USD, rounded half up before submission; storage preserves cents.
  - quantity: number (required) - Fixed-format class — reconciled equivalent vcpu_hour quantity, format Decimal quantity to six decimal places; unit as specified, rounded half up before submission; storage preserves six-place precision.

You can now use this tool by calling `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with tool_name='review_support_invoice_795b85b5' and the required arguments.
